//! with incomplete information about resolve.
//!
//! Part 1: game form + why bilateral arms control fails while third-party
//!         verification sustains trilateral restraint.

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Debug)]
enum Player { A, B, C }

use Player::*;

impl Player {
    fn all() -> [Player; 3] { [A, B, C] }
    /// Directed fear cycle: A fears B, B fears C, C fears A.
    fn fears(self) -> Player { match self { A => B, B => C, C => A } }
    /// Who fears this player (the state threatened by this player'"'s arms).
    fn feared_by(self) -> Player { match self { A => C, B => A, C => B } }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
enum Action { Restrain, Arm }

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
enum Resolve { Low, High }

struct Params {
    w: f64,        // weight of relative arms vs the feared state
    cost: f64,     // cost of arming
    peace: f64,    // dividend when both sides of an edge restrain
    flank: f64,    // exposure to arms of the state that fears you
    hi_mult: f64,  // high resolve values relative advantage more
    delta: f64,    // discount factor
    sanction: f64, // extra cost if cheating is detected
}

fn resolve_mult(t: Resolve, p: &Params) -> f64 {
    match t { Resolve::High => p.hi_mult, Resolve::Low => 1.0 }
}

fn armed(a: Action) -> f64 { if a == Action::Arm { 1.0 } else { 0.0 } }

/// Payoff on the directed edge: state i (type t) vs feared state j's arms.
fn edge_payoff(own: Action, feared: Action, t: Resolve, p: &Params) -> f64 {
    let m = resolve_mult(t, p);
    let security = p.w * (armed(own) - armed(feared)) * m;
    let cost = if own == Action::Arm { p.cost } else { 0.0 };
    let peace = if own == Action::Restrain && feared == Action::Restrain { p.peace } else { 0.0 };
    security - cost + peace
}

/// Full payoff: edge vs feared state, minus flank exposure to the arms of
/// the state that fears you (arms are capabilities on every front).
fn player_payoff(i: Player, prof: [Action; 3], types: [Resolve; 3], p: &Params) -> f64 {
    edge_payoff(prof[i as usize], prof[i.fears() as usize], types[i as usize], p)
        - p.flank * armed(prof[i.feared_by() as usize])
}

fn idx(a: Action) -> usize { if a == Action::Arm { 1 } else { 0 } }

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct Obs { news: f64, ais: f64, lights: f64 } // each in [-1,1], + = de-escalation direction

struct Hyp { mu: Obs, sigma: Obs }

fn ln_gauss(x: f64, mu: f64, sigma: f64) -> f64 {
    let z = (x - mu) / sigma;
    -0.5 * z * z - (sigma * (2.0 * std::f64::consts::PI).sqrt()).ln()
}

fn obs_llr(o: &Obs, h1: &Hyp, h2: &Hyp) -> f64 {
    ln_gauss(o.news, h1.mu.news, h1.sigma.news) - ln_gauss(o.news, h2.mu.news, h2.sigma.news)
        + ln_gauss(o.ais, h1.mu.ais, h1.sigma.ais) - ln_gauss(o.ais, h2.mu.ais, h2.sigma.ais)
        + ln_gauss(o.lights, h1.mu.lights, h1.sigma.lights) - ln_gauss(o.lights, h2.mu.lights, h2.sigma.lights)
}

fn posterior_h1(o: &Obs, h1: &Hyp, h2: &Hyp) -> f64 {
    let llr = obs_llr(o, h1, h2);
    1.0 / (1.0 + (-llr).exp())
}

struct XorShift(u64);
impl XorShift {
    fn next_u64(&mut self) -> u64 {
        let mut x = self.0;
        x ''^= x << 13; x ''^= x >> 7; x ''^= x << 17;
        self.0 = x; x
    }
    fn unif(&mut self) -> f64 { (self.next_u64() >> 11) as f64 / (1u64 << 53) as f64 }
    fn gauss(&mut self) -> f64 {
        let (u1, u2) = (self.unif().max(1e-12), self.unif());
        (-2.0 * u1.ln()).sqrt() * (2.0 * std::f64::consts::PI * u2).cos()
    }
}

fn sample(h: &Hyp, rng: &mut XorShift) -> Obs {
    Obs {
        news: h.mu.news + h.sigma.news * rng.gauss(),
        ais: h.mu.ais + h.sigma.ais * rng.gauss(),
        lights: h.mu.lights + h.sigma.lights * rng.gauss(),
    }
}
